owns: fleet learning failure clustering, analysis requests, candidate, compatibility, application and outcome evidence

payload.privacy_rule: Only DATA-selected bounded normalized scalars plus opaque run and installation refs may leave source-local evidence.
payload.identity_rule: analysis_ref is the SHA-256 identity of policy_ref, normalized cluster dimensions and the bounded evidence frontier; identical evaluation is idempotent while new trusted failures reopen analysis.

payload.acceptance_rule: The candidate materializer rejects private material and requires passed deepest-owner, caller/sibling-sweep, and hostile proofs before publishing an immutable content-addressed candidate revision. Revisions advance only through a linear supersedes_candidate_revision_ref chain; forks, missing ancestors and integrity mismatches reject before repair or convergence.

payload.worker_dispatch_recheck_rule: An assigned operation carries exact current-record conditions for its binding and active policy. The process-session owner checks them before budget and immediately before process dispatch; missing, revoked or changed records reject. This is not permission to select a worker or create a grant.
payload.worker_binding_state_rule: Only explicit active binding state can request work. Missing, revoked, or non-active binding state is rejected automatically and never creates an approval wait.
payload.worker_selection_rule: Select a current profile and tool from their owners. Cost uses the budget owner's integer units. Worker selection is not permission or spend approval. Missing selection leaves analysis saved but not running.
payload.dispatch_rule: The existing evaluation cycle saves the assigned operation first. A later cycle reads the saved operation and requests work only when it exactly matches. The existing process-session owner rechecks the assignment, profile, tool, guard, permission and budget. Failed checks stay visible; retry uses the same reservation key. A changed worker binding produces a new work identity instead of rewriting an earlier assignment.

payload.identity_rule: id = ai-execution-run:<id_namespace>:<native_session_id>; record address = package::ai-execution-history::run::<token(namespace:native_id)> so re-ingestion folds the same record (idempotent)

payload.decision_contract: open descriptor-owned string; no decision taxonomy is compiled into the owner
payload.identity_rule: review_id selects one immutable address; identical replay is idempotent and conflicting replay is rejected

payload.description: Fold session-artifact JSONL files into ai-execution-run write dispatches. Blind: every artifact shape/launcher is a caller-supplied source DATA row ({root, glob, id_namespace, launcher_ref, decoder_capability_ref, agent_ref, extract rules}); a new launcher is one DATA row, zero code. Deterministic run identity makes re-ingestion idempotent; unreadable artifacts emit machine-readable rejections, never silent skips. Backfill is the first invocation of the standing pipeline, not a one-shot.
payload.input: config JSON via stdin or --config: { partition_label, sources[], since?, limit? }

payload.description: Discover authorized installation-local session sources, normalize privacy-safe execution facts, evaluate descriptor-defined failure signals, and publish candidate/compatibility/application/outcome states. Repair and convergence stay with their named canonical owners.
payload.privacy: Raw transcript content, paths, prompts, messages and credentials never enter transferable learning records.

payload.success_rule: Only improved means a comparable later consumer outcome improved; received/current/used remain distinct non-success states.

Improved requires trusted permission-active observations, a distinct chronologically later observed-real attempt satisfying the rule-owned outcome_contract pinned by the candidate outcome_contract_ref, matching applicability, exact evidence that this application changed later selection or execution, and a privacy-safe boolean or finite numeric outcome measure. Publishing uses the published-result contract including complete Production and Customer-loop correlation and a distinct remote object. Other jobs use their own evidence requirements without changing evaluator code.
The newest unambiguous timezone-bound observation wins. A state after failure becomes current only when it explicitly references the failed observation it recovers.

payload.selection_rule: The failure rule owner supplies outcome_contract; each candidate pins its canonical JSON SHA-256 as fleet-outcome-contract:<digest>. This template is not an implicit fallback or permission grant.

payload.name: read-fleet-learning-input
payload.description: Return the current privacy-scoped Fleet-learning input feed for runtime diagnosis and evidence readback.

payload.name: discover-current-agent-sessions
payload.description: Read current local session-source descriptors, verify their installed provider revisions, and ingest each current source without a separate approval record.

payload.name: evaluate-fleet-learning
payload.description: Evaluate current normalized runs against DATA-defined failure, trust, privacy, compatibility, application, and later-outcome evidence; commit every success and rejection state.

payload.name: Save repair request results
payload.description: Save which repair requests failed. A returned request does not mean the repair worked.

payload.name: run-fleet-learning-cycle
payload.description: Run automatic authorized discovery and bounded fleet-learning evaluation in owner order.

payload.name: fleet-learning-on-clock-tick
payload.description: Use the existing clock owner to discover authorized session evidence and evaluate transferable improvements; this package owns no timer, watcher or poller.

payload.name: write-execution-run-record
payload.description: Disabled legacy caller-authored run writer. Authenticated local-session ingestion is owned by action:ingest-one-agent-session-source and never accepts caller-authored run content.

payload.name: derive-acquired-fleet-execution-runs
payload.description: Deterministically derive execution-run candidates from caller-supplied acquired bytes. This compute-only action has no write step and grants no authority; the Fleet ingestion owner supplies the authentic acquisition and verifies the returned acquisition revision before writing.

payload.name: write-authorized-fleet-execution-run-record
payload.description: Acquire authentic private local session bytes inside the owner, derive all runs through the package decoder, reject stale source revisions, and atomically bind every write to the unchanged provider, evidence policy, permission note, trusted time, and destination bases.

payload.name: materialize-fleet-learning-repair-candidate
payload.description: Validate and publish one reviewed privacy-safe repair candidate produced by the canonical work-control analysis path.

payload.name: write-fleet-learning-record
payload.description: Write one evaluator-produced privacy-safe fleet-learning state at its deterministic address.

payload.name: legacy-disabled-ingest-one-agent-session-source
payload.description: Acquire one caller-described session-artifact source through the native local.files owner, fold its bounded local JSONL bytes into deterministic ai-execution-run writes inside contained compute, and commit only the derived run records. Raw transcript bytes never enter durable package records.

payload.name: ingest-one-agent-session-source
payload.description: Ask the Fleet ingestion owner to acquire current local bytes, derive bounded execution runs, reject stale revisions, and commit the resulting records under current scoped permission.

payload.name: ingest-one-agent-session-file
payload.description: Disabled legacy caller-selected exact-file ingestion. Authenticated local-session ingestion resolves its locator from the current provider and permission inside action:ingest-one-agent-session-source.

payload.name: ingest-agent-session-artifacts
payload.description: Standing ingestion: acquire every caller-described session-artifact source through local.files, then fold bounded local JSONL bytes into deterministic ai-execution-run records. Backfill is the first invocation; re-runs update the same addresses.

payload.description: Append ONE immutable ai-execution-step to the run ledger and prove it durable by owner readback. The record-before-effect primitive the actuation gateway (ai-action-guard.govern-computer-action) dispatches to: a forward token can only be minted after this owner has written and confirmed the row. Step vocabulary (step_kind, tool, intent, decision, ...) stays caller DATA; identical replay is idempotent, a conflicting replay is rejected.

Join one installed local session-source provider to the trusted local actor and current runtime partition. The current provider revision is the complete source identity; no approval record is created or required.

payload.description: Confirm current Fleet source admission after re-reading the exact provider and permission without returning its private locator or decoder configuration. Changed, revoked, expired, remote, or ambiguous authority refuses.

input_contract.authority_source: the current provider and evidence policy

payload.description: Acquire current local bytes through the provider-owned scan, derive runs through the package decoder, reject stale or conflicting source revisions, and write the whole bounded set in one atomic operation requiring every authorization and destination basis to remain current. Caller-authored runs are never accepted.

payload.justification: Run ledger record (triage). Net-new runs accumulate unbounded per session (46GB studio); history(keep=3) only bounded re-append, not net-new unique addresses. address = package::ai-execution-history::run::address_token(stable_id) is reconstructable (LIVE-VALIDATED) for ai-execution-run:<ns>:<native> ids; expiring(60d) bounds accumulation while keeping 2 months for triage. Caller-supplied-address runs (write-execution-run-record path) fail-safe skip until they self-describe record_address (L090).
